lines.heard: Find A and N L N Y against X is a straight line for Y equals AE to the power minus NX
lines.said: Find A and N. L N Y against X is a straight line, for Y equals A E to the power minus N X.

lines.heard: Take LN of both sides. LNY = LN of A * E to the power - NX.
lines.said: Take L N of both sides. L N Y equals L N of A times E to the power minus N X.

lines.heard: add power splits a log of a product ln of MN is ln M plus ln N
lines.said: Add Power splits a log of a product: L N of M N is L N M plus L N N.

lines.heard: The power minus NX comes down in front of the LN.
lines.said: The power minus N X comes down in front of the L N.

lines.heard: That leaves LNE which is one because E to the power one is E.
lines.said: That leaves L N E, which is one, because E to the power one is E.

lines.heard: C is ln A -1. Undo the ln A is e to the power -1.
lines.said: C is L N A, negative one. Undo the L N: A is E to the power negative one.

lines.heard: So N is -2 and A is 0.368 correct to three significant figures.
lines.said: So N is negative two, and A is zero point three six eight, correct to three significant figures.
